text:
jess: Hey team — customer (AcmePay) reports intermittent p95 spikes after yesterday's runtime tweak. They see occasional 500s and p95 jumping to ~1.2s from a baseline ~180ms. Sample request IDs: req_9a8b7c6d, req_f1e2d3c4, req_ab12cd34. Can someone help gather a repro pack (curl ids + debug bundle + small promptset + concurrency profile)?

omar: Thanks, can you paste the exact curl you used and the model/route? Also what concurrency / token counts were in their workload?

jess: Route: POST /v1/generate -> model=redwood-2-medium, plan was bursty: 30 concurrent clients, tokens per request ~120 (prompt 40 + gen 80). Repro curl we ran locally (flaky):
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood-2-medium","input":"Summarize the following...","max_tokens":80}'
```
Sometimes we get 200/fast, other times 500 with body: `{"error":"internal server error"}`. Also sometimes a 401 for the same session (maybe token rotation?).

linh: Can you capture three things: 1) curl ids (the req_* values you already have), 2) a HAR of a short burst from customer's client (5–10s), and 3) trigger the support debug bundle for those req ids so we get server traces + kernel logs. For vegeta-style repro, try this to approximate their concurrency:
```bash
cat <<'JSON' >payload.json
{"model":"redwood-2-medium","input":"Summarize the following long doc...","max_tokens":80}
JSON

vegeta attack -duration=2m -rate=40 -connections=30 -body=payload.json -header="Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | vegeta report
```
That should reproduce p95 variability if it's capacity / batching-related. Also add header `X-Trace-Id: my-test-<run>` to correlate.

jess: Copying logs from the last failed run (snippet):
```
[2026-02-12T15:04:22Z] req=req_9a8b7c6d route=/v1/generate status=500 backend_err="kv-cache-miss-timeout"
[2026-02-12T15:04:22Z] req=req_9a8b7c6d srvlat=1.18s host=gpu-3a
[2026-02-12T15:04:24Z] req=req_f1e2d3c4 status=401 auth_err="token-expired"
```
So we see both a backend timeout and an expired token in quick succession. Customer runs a shared token rotation; might surface auth errors interleaved with p95s.

omar: Good data. Plan: 1) request HAR + vegeta run from customer (they can run the command above), 2) jess to open debug bundle for reqs (req_9a8b7c6d, req_f1e2d3c4, req_ab12cd34) and include `X-Trace-Id` values, 3) we will run an internal synthetic with pinned model variant and collect per-gpu KV cache stats. I'll attach a short promptset we should try (mix of short/long outputs):
- prompt A: "Explain blockchain in 2 sentences" (~20 tokens)
- prompt B: "Summarize this 600-word policy doc" (~180 tokens)
- prompt C: developer samples from their production promptset (we need them to send).

sre-bot: debug-bundle job created: bundle_id=67321; status=queued. Use `/support debug collect 67321 --req=req_9a8b7c6d,req_f1e2d3c4,req_ab12cd34` to attach additional logs.

linh: Also, if you see 401s, ask customer to check token TTL and rotation timing. If tokens expire under load there might be a race where a refresh fails and the request falls through to backend; that would show mixed 401/500 in short windows.

jess: I'll collect the HAR + vegeta output and trigger the bundle (doing now). Will paste curl ids and attach the HAR when done. Thanks :thumbsup:

omar: After we have the bundle + vegeta run, we'll correlate timestamps and look at per-request kernel wait / batching metrics. If needed we'll do a short canary rollback to previous runtime config to confirm.

jess: Uploaded HAR + vegeta summary to the ticket and added `X-Trace-Id: acmepay-run-20260212`. Noticed the vegeta run produced p95 spikes around 00:42 into the run matching req_9a8b7c6d window.

linh: Perfect — I see bundle 67321 in the queue; I'll pull traces as soon as it's ready and post findings here.

jess: Closing loop once we have traces. Thanks all.
